v.map.welcome.text: Here is the map, apprentice. Your quest is waiting whenever you are ready.

v.map.land.text: A lit landmark means you have won that place back. Keep going.

v.map.book-open.text: This is the Great Word Book. Pick a page to read again.

v.map.book-torn.text: This page is still torn. Read its story page well to mend it on your quest.

v.map.reread.text: Read it again, as many times as you like. This is just for practice.
